Job Title: Application Developer III ( .NET Developer III) 
 Job Duration: 6 Months Contract role 
 Interview Method: Phone then In Person 
 Address: Fort Mill SC USA 29715 
 Working hours: 8AM to 5PM 
 

 Job Description: 
 

 • Looking for back end software and database developer with C#, SQL Server, and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) experience. 
 

 • Developer will be responsible for working with business analysts and business users to gather and interpret business requirements for data transfers between healthcare systems including data warehouses. 
 

 • The successful candidate will create technical designs within the existing architecture and develop appropriate application to accomplish the task. 
 

 • The candidate will design and develop applications using C# and/or SQL Server Integration Services, TSQL and Stored Procedures to extract and import data. 
 

 • They will complete unit and system testing, perform code reviews, analyze execution plans, and re-factor inefficient code. 
 

 • Collaborates with the business analysts, source system experts, and other team members to determine data extraction and transformation requirements. 
 

 • Collaborates with IT operations and testing organizations to ensure timely releases of projects. 
 

 

 Required skills: 
 

 • SQL Server 
 

 • C#, VB.Net, or Java 
 

 • SSIS 
 

 

 Additional skills: 
 

 • WebAPI / Web services 
 

 • Source Control 
 

 • Team Foundation Server 
 

 • Agile, Scrum, Waterfall
 

 
 
 

 Looking for back end software and database developer with C#, SQL Server, and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) experience.
